sources.snippet: Native macOS app for local AI image generation and editing on Apple silicon: Z-Image Turbo, Qwen-Image-2.1, Krea 2 Turbo, Anima Turbo and MOSS-Image in Swift and Metal, fp32, checked against diffusers. Never takes more memory than its budget: ¾ of the Mac's memory minus 2 GB. - gwenn-ha-dev/Siliconed

sources.snippet: Krea 2 Turbo, Z-Image Turbo, Qwen-Image-2.1, Anima Turbo and MOSS-Image, native in Swift and Metal. Every computation planned for this chip, from a measure of its engines — GPU, CPU matrix unit, Neural Engine. Offline, fp32, checked against the reference, within a fixed memory budget.
